name: isaac_like
display_name: ISAAC-CE (32 nm analog ReRAM, Shafiee 2016, simulated), 16128 arrays of 128 x 128

named: one ADC on the fused accumulator (per-array ADC not built, W47)
faithfulness.note: A design-space study, not a fabricated chip. Every energy constant multiplies a published power by the 100 ns cycle of the paper (isaac_like.json validity, shafiee2016isaac Table I).

notes: [U-A] cores_per_tile 96 is ISAAC's tile: 'The optimal design point has 8 128×128 arrays, 8 ADCs per IMA, and 12 IMAs per tile' (shafiee2016isaac, Section VIII), 12 x 8 = 96 arrays sharing a tile's eDRAM buffer, bus and its quarter of a router (Table I's tile block), so the 16128 arrays are Table I's 168 tiles (14 x 12) and the tile's components are priced once per tile. allow_coalescing and allow_neuron_splitting are true: "Since the operation requires a logical crossbar array of size 256 x 256, it must be spread across 4 physical crossbar arrays of size 128 x 128", whose ADC results "are then fed to the shift-and-add units, where the results are merged with the output register (OR) in the IMA", and "may undergo another step of shift-and-adds and merging with the central OR in the tile if the convolution is spread across multiple IMAs" (shafiee2016isaac, Section V, the Figure 4 example): a dot product's rows (partial sums) and its output columns span several arrays. onchip_arithmetic declares the lane subset L, E and P (on by default for value-domain chips, owner 2026-10-15; the off ablation declares classes [] through target_overrides with a note): ReLU as the law's clamp, a fused add and a requantizing average pool run on chip when the program is on the integer path (readout_law); a float value program keeps its host ops. The lane block is ng45_os_lane (an output-stage lane synthesized at 45 nm and 1.1 V, arith_toggle.md section 6, estimated; the resolver scales its area by node^2 and its energy by node x V^2 to this target's node, naming the factor in each row), one lane per 64 output columns, so 2 lanes per core (128 output columns per array). The certified function applies one ADC to each column's fused accumulator, while the cost model prices one conversion per array: the two are identical where adc_bits reaches an array's accumulator width, and below it the checked accuracy is not the priced chip's (per-array ADC, W47, not built). The bundle binds activation_bits 16: "Instead of a single voltage level that represents a 16-bit fixed-point number, we provide 16 voltage levels sequentially, where voltage level i is a 0/1 binary input representing bit i of the 16-bit input number." (shafiee2016isaac, Section V 'Input Voltages and DACs', PDF p.5); a run at another width declares it through target_overrides with a note. [U-C4] The geometry counts two-bit cells and a 16-bit weight takes eight of them along its row, so core_fields cells_per_weight 8 with weight_cell_rows 1 (the eight cells on adjacent columns of its row): "It is impractical to represent a 16-bit synaptic weight in a single memristor cell [26]. We therefore represent one 16-bit synaptic weight with 16/w w-bit cells located in the same row. For the rest of this discussion, we assume w = 2 because it emerges as a sweet spot in our design space exploration." (shafiee2016isaac, Section V 'Synaptic Weights and ADCs', p.5): 16 / 2 = 8, the cells_per_weight the profile's bit_sliced_crossbar conversion model declares (one quantity, stated twice, refused by name where they differ). Each 128 x 128 array therefore holds 128 x 16 weights (the bundle's cores), its cells, rows and columns stay 128 x 128, and a weight write writes each of its eight cells. The count is the chip's at its bound 16-bit weights (16 / w); a run that overrides weight_bits keeps it, a boundary stated here.

stated.quote: Each tile is composed of eDRAM buffers to store input values, a number of in-situ multiply-accumulate (IMA) units, and output registers to aggregate results, all connected with a shared bus.
We target 16-bit fixed-point arithmetic, partially because prior work has shown that 16-bit arithmetic is sufficient for this class of machine learning algorithms [8], [21]

unstated.note: The source's biases are the offset encoding of signed weights and inputs (Section V 'Encoding to Handle Signed Arithmetic'); it states no neuron bias circuit. The registered geometry's bias row is the description's assumption.

unstated.note: An ADC per array, shared by its 128 columns, reads each bit-serial input cycle of the 2-bit cells, merged by shift-and-add (Section V): a per-array converter on partial products, not the toolchain's per-core law on the fused accumulator (W47's per-array ADC, not built). The deployment declares the identity converter on the fused accumulator, the bundle's named idealization.

The tile has shift-and-add, sigmoid and max-pool units (Section V 'Overview'): a sigmoid, not the toolchain's ReLU clamp, and max pooling, not average pooling. The lanes L, E and P are the owner's ruling of 2026-10-15 (on by default for value-domain chips) on the estimated ng45_os_lane block.
The crossbars hold programmed memristor weights; the description declares no run-time writable matrix.
